description: Search and filter every tracked Base yield opportunity: id, protocol, market, type, quoted APY, TVL and a risk band (low, moderate, high, very_high). Useful for finding candidates and their ids. Scores, sustainable APY, expected returns, slippage and position sizing are in the paid card (/api/v1/opportunity/:id) and screeners (/api/v1/yields). Free, at most 60 calls an hour per client. Free; at most 60 calls an hour per client.

min_apy.description: Lowest quoted APY to include, in percent.

q.description: Search words over protocol, market and asset names (letters, digits, spaces, dots, dashes, underscores; at most 60).

risk_max.description: Highest risk to include (0-100, lower is lower modelled risk). On this free route it is rounded up to the edge of its risk band: 25 (low), 50 (moderate), 75 (high) or 100 (very_high).

stable_only.description: Only opportunities whose principal is a stablecoin.
